system_prompt_template: You are interacting with another agent in a game of strategic interaction. You have two options: either option A or option B. If you choose A and your coplayer also chooses A, you will both earn 7 points. If you choose A while your coplayer chooses B, you will earn 4 points and your coplayer will earn 12 points. If you choose B while your coplayer chooses A, you will earn 12 points and your coplayer will earn 4 points. If you choose B and your coplayer also chooses B, you will both earn 5 points.
prompt_template: Here is history of your last action {history_you} and others' last action {history_other} (0 means defection, 1 means cooperation, -1 means no history). You are agent {your_index}(the index starts with 0), you current connection status list with others is {connection_status}(0 means no connection, 1 means connection), the list of history action with all other agents is {others_last_action_list}(0 means defection, 1 means cooperation, -1 means no connection, note it will be always [-1,-1] in your own index)

actions.action_description: choose your decision in current round
choose agents index to connect, choose -1 means keep the same without connecting to new agents
choose agents index to disconnect, choose -1 means keep the same without connecting to new agents
